features.label: Rejected the label
features.detail: Denied being an existentialist and meant it. Filing him next to Sartre erases the actual disagreement.

features.label: Absurdity is not despair
features.detail: The argument ends in defiance, not resignation. Most summaries get this exactly backwards.

features.label: Tested before written
features.detail: Ran an underground resistance paper under occupation. The philosophy had already been used before it was published.
